audited_source_corrections.action: Replaced the undeclared C in the negation of A subset A union B with the actual target set A union B.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The proof is negating A subset A union B and correctly states nearby that some x in A is outside A union B, but one parenthetical explanation abruptly says outside C although C is not introduced in this example.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: மறுக்கப்படும் உட்கணக் கூற்றின் வலப்புறமான A ஒன்றிப்பு B யையே குறிப்பிட்டு, தொடர்பில்லாத C ஐ நீக்குகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Keeping C and making readers infer an undeclared identification of C with A union B.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Not every x in A belongs to A union B is negated by a witness x in A and x not in A union B; the subsequent formal line and contradiction use precisely that target set.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the witness to A not subset A union B lie outside A union B rather than an undeclared C?
